name: EU AI Act
description: Standard tier — defence-in-depth for high-risk AI systems. Citations are at article granularity only; the paragraph actually engaged, and every check that is a proxy rather than evidence, is named in each control set's description and in the citation table in ../README.md. Verified against CELEX 32024R1689.

controlSets.name: Art. 9(2)(d) — Risk Management Measures
controlSets.description: Article 9 requires a risk management system; 9(2)(d) requires 'the adoption of appropriate and targeted risk management measures'. It names no technical control, so every check in this set is a proxy for a documented measure. Container hardening is more directly an Article 15(5) cybersecurity measure, and a liveness probe is more directly an Article 15(4) resilience measure.

controls.name: AI containers run as non-root
controls.description: High-risk AI systems must not run with root privileges

checks.name: Container runs as non-root
checks.celExpression: has(object.spec) && has(object.spec.containers) && size(object.spec.containers) > 0 && (object.spec.containers + (has(object.spec.initContainers) ? object.spec.initContainers : []) + (has(object.spec.ephemeralContainers) ? object.spec.ephemeralContainers : [])).all(c, (has(c.securityContext) && has(c.securityContext.runAsNonRoot)) ? c.securityContext.runAsNonRoot == true : (has(object.spec.securityContext) && has(object.spec.securityContext.runAsNonRoot) && object.spec.securityContext.runAsNonRoot == true))

controls.name: No privilege escalation
controls.description: AI containers must not allow privilege escalation

checks.name: Privilege escalation disabled
checks.celExpression: has(object.spec) && has(object.spec.containers) && size(object.spec.containers) > 0 && (object.spec.containers + (has(object.spec.initContainers) ? object.spec.initContainers : []) + (has(object.spec.ephemeralContainers) ? object.spec.ephemeralContainers : [])).all(c, has(c.securityContext) && has(c.securityContext.allowPrivilegeEscalation) && c.securityContext.allowPrivilegeEscalation == false)

controls.name: No privileged containers
controls.description: AI containers must not run in privileged mode

checks.name: Privileged mode disabled
checks.celExpression: has(object.spec) && has(object.spec.containers) && size(object.spec.containers) > 0 && (object.spec.containers + (has(object.spec.initContainers) ? object.spec.initContainers : []) + (has(object.spec.ephemeralContainers) ? object.spec.ephemeralContainers : [])).all(c, !(has(c.securityContext) && has(c.securityContext.privileged) && c.securityContext.privileged == true))

controls.name: Read-only root filesystem
controls.description: Containers must use read-only root filesystem to limit attack surface

checks.name: Read-only root filesystem
checks.celExpression: has(object.spec) && has(object.spec.containers) && size(object.spec.containers) > 0 && (object.spec.containers + (has(object.spec.initContainers) ? object.spec.initContainers : []) + (has(object.spec.ephemeralContainers) ? object.spec.ephemeralContainers : [])).all(c, has(c.securityContext) && has(c.securityContext.readOnlyRootFilesystem) && c.securityContext.readOnlyRootFilesystem == true)

controls.name: Drop all capabilities
controls.description: Containers must drop all Linux capabilities

checks.name: All capabilities dropped
checks.celExpression: has(object.spec) && has(object.spec.containers) && size(object.spec.containers) > 0 && (object.spec.containers + (has(object.spec.initContainers) ? object.spec.initContainers : []) + (has(object.spec.ephemeralContainers) ? object.spec.ephemeralContainers : [])).all(c, has(c.securityContext) && has(c.securityContext.capabilities) && has(c.securityContext.capabilities.drop) && c.securityContext.capabilities.drop.exists(d, d == 'ALL'))

controls.name: Liveness probe configured
controls.description: AI workloads must have liveness probes for fault detection

controlSets.name: Art. 10 — Data and Data Governance
controlSets.description: Article 10 governs the quality and governance of TRAINING, VALIDATION and TESTING data sets (10(2)(a)-(h)). It does not regulate runtime handling or retention of operational data. `data-classification-label` is a weak proxy for 10(2)(a)/(e). `pii-handling-annotation` is MIS-ATTRIBUTED: Article 10's only personal-data provision is 10(5), which permits processing special categories strictly for bias detection and correction; runtime PII handling is a GDPR obligation. `data-retention-annotation` is MIS-ATTRIBUTED: Article 10 imposes no retention period (10(5)(e) requires deletion of special-category bias data only); log retention of at least six months is Article 26(6) and QMS data retention is Article 17(1)(f).

controls.name: Data classification label present
controls.description: Workloads handling training data must declare classification

controls.name: PII handling annotation
controls.description: Workloads must declare whether they process PII

controls.name: Data retention annotation
controls.description: Workloads must declare data retention policy

controlSets.name: Art. 14 — Human Oversight
controlSets.description: Verified. Article 14(4)(d)-(e) requires that the oversight person be enabled to disregard, override or reverse the output and to interrupt the system, and 14(3)(b) allows measures the deployer implements. A declared oversight label, approval gate and override contact are declarations that such measures exist, not evidence of them.

controls.name: Human-in-the-loop label present
controls.description: AI workloads must declare their human oversight level

controls.name: Approval gate annotation
controls.description: High-risk AI decisions must have an approval gate configured

controls.name: Human override contact
controls.description: Workloads must declare a human override contact

controlSets.name: Art. 15(4) — Robustness and Resilience
controlSets.description: Verified against Article 15(4): resilience 'regarding errors, faults or inconsistencies', achievable 'through technical redundancy solutions, which may include backup or fail-safe plans'. Resource bounds, probes and a replica floor are redundancy and fail-safe measures. Note that CYBERSECURITY is Article 15(5), not 15(4); no check in this set evidences 15(5).

controls.name: Resource limits defined
controls.description: AI workloads must have resource limits to prevent resource exhaustion

checks.name: CPU and memory limits defined
checks.description: Every container and init container must bound both cpu and memory in resources.limits. Ephemeral containers are excluded: the Kubernetes EphemeralContainer schema forbids resources on them.
checks.celExpression: has(object.spec) && has(object.spec.containers) && size(object.spec.containers) > 0 && (object.spec.containers + (has(object.spec.initContainers) ? object.spec.initContainers : [])).all(c, has(c.resources) && has(c.resources.limits) && 'cpu' in c.resources.limits && 'memory' in c.resources.limits)

controls.name: Resource requests defined
controls.description: AI workloads must declare resource requests for scheduling

checks.name: CPU and memory requests defined
checks.description: Every container and init container must bound both cpu and memory in resources.requests. Ephemeral containers are excluded: the Kubernetes EphemeralContainer schema forbids resources on them.
checks.celExpression: has(object.spec) && has(object.spec.containers) && size(object.spec.containers) > 0 && (object.spec.containers + (has(object.spec.initContainers) ? object.spec.initContainers : [])).all(c, has(c.resources) && has(c.resources.requests) && 'cpu' in c.resources.requests && 'memory' in c.resources.requests)

controls.name: Readiness probe configured
controls.description: AI workloads must have readiness probes for availability

controls.name: Minimum replica count
controls.description: High-risk AI workloads should have multiple replicas

checks.name: At least 2 replicas specified
checks.description: Placeholder: replica count is a controller-level fact (Deployment/StatefulSet spec.replicas). The engine evaluates a pod spec, which never carries replicas, so this control is not evaluable here. Pod fixtures that set spec.replicas made it a fake green.

controlSets.name: Art. 17(1) — Quality Management System
controlSets.description: Article 17(1) requires a documented quality management system; 17(1)(a) covers 'procedures for the management of modifications' and 17(1)(e) 'technical specifications ... to be applied'. Digest pinning, a trusted-registry allow-list and a policy-version label are proxies for those procedures: a pod spec cannot evidence that a QMS exists. Supply-chain integrity is also engaged by Article 15(5), which names 'pre-trained components used in training (model poisoning)'.

controls.name: Image pinned by digest
controls.description: Container images must use digest references for reproducibility

checks.name: Image uses sha256 digest
checks.celExpression: has(object.spec) && has(object.spec.containers) && size(object.spec.containers) > 0 && (object.spec.containers + (has(object.spec.initContainers) ? object.spec.initContainers : []) + (has(object.spec.ephemeralContainers) ? object.spec.ephemeralContainers : [])).all(c, has(c.image) && c.image.matches('@sha256:[a-f0-9]{64}$'))

controls.name: Trusted registry enforcement
controls.description: Images must originate from approved registries

checks.name: Image from trusted registry
checks.celExpression: has(object.spec) && has(object.spec.containers) && size(object.spec.containers) > 0 && (object.spec.containers + (has(object.spec.initContainers) ? object.spec.initContainers : []) + (has(object.spec.ephemeralContainers) ? object.spec.ephemeralContainers : [])).all(c, has(c.image) && (c.image.startsWith('zot.local/') || c.image.startsWith('registry.internal/') || c.image.startsWith('ghcr.io/controlplaneio/') || c.image.startsWith('ghcr.io/controlplaneio-in-toto/') || c.image.startsWith('ghcr.io/controlplaneio-fluxcd/') || c.image.startsWith('gcr.io/distroless/')))
checks.description: Every container, init container and ephemeral container image comes from a trusted organisation prefix (listed in AGENT-CONTEXT.md); a whole public registry is never trusted.

controls.name: Policy version label
controls.description: Workloads must declare the policy version they comply with
